basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. I've always had a soft spot for retro gaming systems, especially the N64. During the day, I work as a software developer, but by night, you'll find me tinkering with old consoles or diving into the latest discussions on electric vehicles. I'm happily married, and my partner shares my love for gaming. My online hours are mostly late evenings and weekends, as that's when I can unwind and delve into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas and have been working in software development for about 5 years. My interest in retro gaming started as a childhood passion, and I've since built up a collection of consoles and games. I've learned a lot from online communities and forums, where I've picked up tips on console maintenance and repair.
